LESSON 16 / 37 • ORIGINAL CHECKLIST
Pseudo-classes and pseudo-
elements

Pseudo-classes select a state or condition; pseudo-elements target a part of an element or a
generated box.
:hover, :focus-visible, :nth-child වJගේ pseudo-classes වලින් state Jහතෝ condition එකකේ
Jතතෝරනවා. ::before, ::after වJගේ pseudo-elements වලින් element එJකේ Jකාටසකේ Jහතෝ generated
A button has keyboard focus and an added decorative marker.

Read the diagram: 1. Hover activates a state. 2. Focus-visible gives a visible focus indicator.
3. ::before creates a decorative box before text.
Hover සහ focus buttons වල state Jවනස්. පෙහළ label එJකේ star එක ::before වලින් add කරලා තිJයනවා.

Expected result: Hover and keyboard focus change button styles; label receives a decorative
star.
Interview question: What is the difference between :hover and ::before?
Answer: :hover selects a state; ::before creates or targets a generated pseudo-element.
Remember: Single colon state; double colon part (modern syntax).
Practice: Add a hover and focus-visible style to a link.
